title: The Veiled Believer in the Tyrant's Court
intro: Within the gilded halls of the most arrogant ruler known to the Quran — where defiance of the Divine defined every edict — one soul walked among the privileged, hiding the most dangerous of secrets in plain sight. This individual carried a faith so forbidden within those walls that its discovery would mean certain death. Yet conviction burned like a flame beneath the ashes, and when the moment arrived, truth rang out with a courage that shook the very foundation of the tyrant's palace.
clues: I lived among the inner circle of the most powerful and arrogant ruler of my time, surrounded by luxury and influence.
I concealed my true belief deep within my heart, fearing for my life from those who ruled with cruelty and oppression.
When my people doubted and wavered in the face of truth, I stepped forward to warn them of the tragic fate that had befallen past nations who rejected their Lord's messengers.
I reminded my people of the story of a beloved young dreamer who was cast down by his own kin yet rose to great authority in a distant land.
I urged my people not to obey the ruler who led them astray, instead inviting them to follow me along the path of righteousness and guidance.
I openly spoke the truth even though the tyrant's followers threatened to stone me or expel me from the land.

identity.label: Who Am I?
options: The Hidden Believer from Pharaoh's Family
A Patient Patriarch Who Wept Blind Until His Son Returned
A Faithful Servant Whose Skin Disease Was Eventually Cured
A Sinful Son Who Rejected a Prophet's Invitation to Board the Ark
A Ruthless Tyrant Who Claimed Divinity for Themselves
identity.answer: The Hidden Believer from Pharaoh's Family

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Concealing faith in a tyrant's court
Suffering blindness from years of weeping
Being tested by the loss of family and severe affliction
Building a great ship while being ridiculed
Enduring the scorching heat of a great fire
trial.answer: Concealing faith in a tyrant's court

location.label: Key Element
options: Pharaoh's palace
A mountain peak where an ark was constructed
A sacred valley beneath Mount Sinai
A magnificent garden with two flowing streams
A crystal throne above an underground river

outcome.label: Outcome
options: Divine protection while the oppressors met their destruction
Was reunited with family after decades of separation
Was granted patience, restored health, and a larger family
Was saved on a boat while the rest of the world drowned
Was rescued unharmed from flames by the command of Allah
outcome.answer: Divine protection while the oppressors met their destruction

arabic: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَـٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
verse: And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct. (40:38)
